description: I build this model only once or twice a year. The construction methods are very traditional- either lugged or fillet brazed. While this style of frame may be the most artistic, it is also by far the most labor intensive. There was a time when all the frames I built were like this. Anyone who orders a Signature road gets to choose from a variety of lugs and fork crowns and tube profiles. While I am not known for building this style of frame, it is the style that I started with so I continue to offer it. Frame and fork come as a package. I do offer custom stems as well. These frames come with a painted finish, not powdercoat like the other frames I build. The catalyzed paint is thin and shows the workmanship better than powdercoat. There are really too many options to list- If you are considering a Signature, I’ll bet that you will be able to tell me what you want- you have probably been riding bikes like this for years.

components.description: Frame and fork come as a package.
